title: None data is show and heartbeat error occured after I restart skywalking
body:
### Bug
- Which version of SkyWalking, OS and JRE?
  5.0.0-beta2  CentOS 7.2   JRE 1.8

- What happen?
I cleared Es data and restart collector and agents.
After I restart,
"Exception while fetching data (/getTopNSlowService) : null" is show on the website.And error occurs in the log of Collector:

### Requirement or improvement
- How to solve the problem "Exception while fetching data (/getTopNSlowService) : null" ?
author: lovesea42

comments.body: You didn't just reboot, you deleted data in storage. The system can't run in that way. You need to reboot agents too.
Thanks,I found after I reboot all the agents ,it works

satisfaction_conditions: Instructions for resolving the heartbeat error after clearing Elasticsearch data
Explanation of the proper restart sequence when clearing data in SkyWalking
Clarification on why 'Exception while fetching data (/getTopNSlowService)' occurs
Information about data consistency requirements between SkyWalking components

_classification.category: Requires build environment but hard to be dockerized
